provenance: Real output of git ls-tree as src/gates/merge-preconditions.ts blobAt runs it (git --literal-pathspecs ls-tree -z <rev> -- <path>) on the side each arm makes unreadable or absent, captured 2026-09-30 by the M6-P5 implementer with git 2.43.0 against the scratch repositories test/merge-preconditions.test.ts stages in stageReadFailure. A symlink lists as mode 120000 blob, which blobAt refuses to read as one regular file; a deleted file lists as nothing, which blobAt reads as absent. Blob ids are of the link target names and file contents, so no stdout byte is rewritten and only <base> and <head> in argv are placeholders. JSON escapes NUL as \u0000 and TAB as \t, so this file is ASCII.
